items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and prioritize draining approved execution and repair backlog. Evidence: 123 approved proposals lack execution, 12 requests failed, 23 repair follow-ups remain open, and SearchWoot source rights, legal, security, accuracy, and measurement gates remain blocked. Unknown: owner disposition on preparing an unsent Woot permission request. Should we (A) prepare the unsent request for owner/counsel review, or (B) stop pursuing public beta and maintain private indefinitely?

Recommendation: do not adopt third-party repositories yet. The MarkItDown and shadcn/ui leads are suitable only for bounded prototypes; no production or revenue evidence exists, and runtime/dependency compatibility remains unverified.
